    Ideal quotients of preadditive categories #

    Mathlib supplies quotients by a categorical congruence. This file packages a two-sided additive Hom ideal as such a congruence, equips the quotient with its induced preadditive structure, and proves that the quotient functor kills exactly the ideal.

    Congruence modulo the given Hom ideal.
